entities.summary: Piers Francis is an English rugby union footballer who plays in the fly-half and occasionally inside centre position. His current club is Kurita Water Gush, United he has previously played for Northampton Saints, the Blues in Super Rugby, Edinburgh,Doncaster Knights & Bath.
